meta.title: 炒股谁在赚钱？养马村的割韭菜寓言
meta.title_en: Who Makes Money in Stocks? The Horse Village Allegory

scenes.title_cn: 养马村的税费与高价收马
scenes.title_en: Taxes and a rich merchant buying horses
scenes.context: 讲者用养马村的故事开场：村长定规则收税，商人进村高价收马。
sentences: 前几天有个小伙子问我：这个炒股游戏到底是谁在赚钱，为什么我总赚不到钱？
A young man asked me the other day: who's actually making money in this stock game, and why can't I ever win?
炒股游戏：the stock game
以后每人卖马的时候要给村里交个千分之一的费用，同时买的人和卖的人还要另外再交个万分之几的费用。
From now on, every horse sale pays the village a 0.1 percent fee, and both buyer and seller chip in a few ten-thousandths more.
千分之一：0.1 percent
商人来到我们村就收马，开口价就是十万块钱一匹，村民前仆后继地把马都卖了。
A famous merchant came and started buying horses at 100,000 each, and the villagers rushed to sell.
前仆后继地卖：rushed to sell
paraphrase: 收税+高价→钱流向组织者
Fees and bidding funnel money to the organizers.
卖出即离场→早期卖出者还不算输
Selling early isn't losing yet — it's exiting early.
scenes.speak: A young man asked me the other day: who's actually making money in this stock game, and why can't I ever win? From now on, every horse sale pays the village a 0.1 percent fee, and both buyer and seller chip in a few ten-thousandths more. A famous merchant came and started buying horses at 100,000 each, and the villagers rushed to sell.

scenes.title_en: Price hikes, FOMO, and borrowed money
scenes.context: 商人抬价制造后悔，再把马拉回村低价卖，村民借钱追高。
sentences: 商人看大家都收得差不多了，于是又给涨了个价，三十万块钱一匹。
Once the merchant saw the herd was thin, he raised the price to 300,000 per horse.
看收得差不多了：saw the herd was thin
大家看都收得差不多了，于是又把手里全部卖掉了。
Seeing the rally, they sold everything they had left.
把手里全部卖掉：sold everything they had
三十万买，第二天就可以卖六十万，一天就翻倍，赶紧买！
Buy at 300,000, sell at 600,000 tomorrow — double in a day! Buy fast!
一天就翻倍：double in a day
paraphrase: 涨价-后悔-回购→追高情绪被操纵
Price hikes, regret, and a "discount" repurchase are how the crowd is played.
翻倍诱惑→催生借钱追高
The "double in a day" lure drives people to borrow and chase.
scenes.speak: Once the merchant saw the herd was thin, he raised the price to 300,000 per horse. Seeing the rally, they sold everything they had left. Buy at 300,000, sell at 600,000 tomorrow — double in a day! Buy fast!

scenes.title_en: The merchant vanishes: winners and losers
scenes.context: 商人带着马消失，讲者点出三类赢家和最惨的输家。
sentences: 但是也有一小部分人比较理智，他心想这可能有点坑，就没买，观望了一下。
A small minority stayed rational — suspecting a trap, they held back and watched.
比较理智：stayed rational
等到第二天再去卖马的时候，发现商人不在了，大家瞬间都懵了，才知道上当了。
The next day, the merchant was gone — the villagers froze, realizing they'd been scammed.
上当了：been scammed
第一个赚的是村长，第二个是眼尖没上当的那批人，第三个人就是商人。
The winners: the village chief, the sharp-eyed few who stayed out, and the merchant.
眼尖没上当：the sharp-eyed few
paraphrase: The rational few dodge the harvest.
赢家三类→输家是接盘者
Three winners, and the losers are those left holding the bag.
scenes.speak: A small minority stayed rational — suspecting a trap, they held back and watched. The next day, the merchant was gone — the villagers froze, realizing they'd been scammed. The winners: the village chief, the sharp-eyed few who stayed out, and the merchant.

practice: Who's actually making money in this game?
Everyone rushed in when the price doubled in a day.
The few who stayed rational walked away unscathed.
They only realized they'd been scammed when it was too late.
pitfalls: ✓ 地道说法：He got scammed / fleeced.
割韭菜用 get fleeced 或 get scammed 表达。
✕ 直译腔：Buy low and sell high, double in one day.
✓ 地道说法：Double in a day — buy now!
double in a day 表达翻倍叙事更口语。
✕ 直译腔：The merchant took the horses away at night.
✓ 地道说法：The merchant disappeared overnight with the horses.
disappeared overnight 表达「一夜消失」更生动。
✕ 直译腔：They borrowed money from the village chief to buy horses.
✓ 地道说法：Some even borrowed from the chief to buy horses.
直接用 borrow from 更简洁。
shifts: 先看清谁在赚钱、谁在接盘
借钱追高是最惨输家的结构
